lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Were you just… sleeping? Standing up?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Your eyes were closed for like ten seconds.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: That's all you need. Ten seconds and you're recharged.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I don't think that's how sleep works.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: Don't tell anyone though. I have a reputation.
